items.reasoning: Evaluated under Mode A (Objective Evaluation), the report properly sets up the zero-shot protocol by training exclusively on random maps and evaluating on unseen Maze, Room, and Warehouse maps (Section 4.3), but the quantitative results deviate severely from the paper and fail to beat baselines. Specifically, LNS2+RL achieved 0% success rate on both Room (0/32) and Warehouse (0/32, losing to LNS2's 9%) and merely tied LNS2 on Maze (12%), while yielding 8.5%–20.7% worse colliding-pair counts across all unseen structures. These severe metric deficits stem from significant methodological flaws, including replacing a deep MARL network with a 900-parameter single-layer NumPy MLP that relies on costly per-agent DP features, omitting LNS2's failure-based neighborhood, and testing on only 8 instances per configuration.
